name: Sim0 Nutrition Facts Labels for WooCommerce
author: joesimo

sections.description:
Food and drink shops often show the Nutrition Facts panel as a photo of the package. Photos are hard to read on a phone, can’t be searched, and screen readers skip them. Sim0 Nutrition Facts Labels for WooCommerce lets you type the panel in once and shows it on the product page as real HTML text, laid out like the FDA Nutrition Facts label.

What the panel shows

  • Servings per container and serving size
  • Calories per serving
  • Total Fat, Saturated Fat, Trans Fat, Cholesterol, Sodium, Total Carbohydrate, Dietary Fiber, Total Sugars, Includes Added Sugars and Protein
  • Vitamin D, Calcium, Iron and Potassium
  • % Daily Value worked out from the FDA Daily Values for adults and children 4 years and older, with vitamins and minerals rounded the FDA way (to the nearest 2%, 5% or 10%). Type your own percent to match your package exactly
  • Amounts such as 0.5 or less than 1 (type <1)
  • Ingredients and a Contains line for allergens

Rows you leave empty are not shown.

Quick start

  1. Edit a product and open the Nutrition facts tab in the Product data box.
  2. Pick Nutrition Facts, then type the servings, calories and amounts exactly as rounded on your package.
  3. Update the product. A saved preview shows in the editor, and the panel shows on the product page.

Where the panel shows

  • In its own product tab, next to Description (you can rename the tab)
  • Below the add to cart button
  • Anywhere with the [sim0_nutrition_facts] shortcode, or [sim0_nutrition_facts id="123"] for a given product

Choose under WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Nutrition facts. Works with classic themes such as Storefront and with block themes such as Twenty Twenty-Five.

Other details

  • Simple and variable products. For a variable product, the panel set on the product covers all of its variations
  • Bad values are not saved, and a message tells you which field to fix
  • Developer filter sim0nfl_panel_html for the panel HTML
  • Declares compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart and Checkout blocks
  • No tracking, no ads, no external requests

Important

This plugin displays the values you enter. It does not work out nutrient amounts from a recipe and it is not legal advice. What you show must match the label on the product.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Sim0 Nutrition Facts Labels”, then install and activate it.
  3. Edit a product, open the Nutrition facts tab in the Product data box, fill in the panel and update the product.
sections.faq:
I activated the plugin but my shoppers see nothing. What do I do?

Nothing shows until a Nutrition Facts panel is set up on a product. After activation, a short notice on the Plugins screen links to your newest product: open the Nutrition facts tab in the Product data box and pick a panel type, then update the product. The notice goes away once that is done, or for good when you dismiss it. The plugin shows no notices on other admin screens. The settings page also says whether anything is showing yet.

Where do I enter the panel?

Edit a simple or variable product and open Product data > Nutrition facts.

Where are the settings?

WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Nutrition facts.

Why does Protein show no % Daily Value?

On the FDA label the protein percent is optional and needs a corrected protein figure, so it shows only when you type it in the % Daily Value box.

My package shows a different percent. Which one is used?

Leave the % Daily Value box empty to have it worked out from the amount. Type a whole number to show the percent printed on your package instead.

Can I show Supplement Facts or a different panel for each variation?

Not in this plugin. It shows one Nutrition Facts panel per product.

Does the plugin send any data anywhere?

No. It makes no external requests and does not track anything. All data stays in your WordPress database.

What is removed when I delete the plugin?

The two store settings. The panels you typed stay on your products, so a reinstall brings them back.

short_description: Show a Nutrition Facts panel, ingredients and allergens on WooCommerce product pages as clean, searchable text instead of label photos.
